newsitem.title: UK: UK gilts end off highs after gaining on CBI.
newsitem.headline: UK gilts end off highs after gaining on CBI.

text.p: UK gilt futures ended just a shade steadier after coming off earlier highes reached after the CBI distributive trades survey showed a surprise slowdown in sales growth for May.

Some analysts said this may have tipped the balance against an increase in official British interest rates when the Bank of England's monetary policy committee announces the outcome of its two-day inaugural meeting at 1100 GMT on Friday.
The September gilt contract ended at 113-13/32, just 1/32 up on Thursday but well down on the mid-session high of 113-25/32.
